name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
description: Interruptive confirmation modal built on ui-sdk that requires an explicit action or cancel.
docs: Bind with v-model:open. Unlike Dialog, clicking outside does not close an AlertDialog; focus moves to AlertDialogCancel on open. Both AlertDialogAction and AlertDialogCancel accept variant and size props from buttonVariants.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialog as AlertDialogRoot } from '@ui-sdk/vue/alert-dialog'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AlertDialogProps = {
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AlertDialogProps>(), {
  defaultOpen: undefined,
})

const open = defineModel<boolean>('open')
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialogRoot v-model:open="open" :default-open="defaultOpen" v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot />
  </AlertDialogRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { AlertDialogTrigger as SdkAlertDialogTrigger } from '@ui-sdk/vue/alert-dialog'
import { RenderChild } from '@/lib/render-child'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AlertDialogTriggerProps = {
  as?: string | Component
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AlertDialogTriggerProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  asChild: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkAlertDialogTrigger v-bind="$attrs" :class="!asChild && 'h-auto border-0 bg-transparent p-0'">
    <template #render="{ props: part }">
      <RenderChild v-if="asChild" v-bind="part"><slot /></RenderChild>
      <component :is="as" v-else v-bind="part"><slot /></component>
    </template>
  </SdkAlertDialogTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import {
  AlertDialogBackdrop,
  AlertDialogContent as SdkAlertDialogContent,
} from '@ui-sdk/vue/alert-dialog'
import type { DialogFinalFocus, DialogInitialFocus } from '@ui-sdk/vue/dialog'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AlertDialogContentProps = {
  initialFocus?: DialogInitialFocus
  finalFocus?: DialogFinalFocus
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AlertDialogContentProps>(), {
  initialFocus: '[data-p0seid0n-alert-cancel]',
  finalFocus: undefined,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialogBackdrop
    class="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-[color-mix(in_oklab,var(--color-ink)_45%,transparent)] motion-safe:animate-fade-in data-ending-style:motion-safe:animate-fade-out"
  />
  <SdkAlertDialogContent
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :initial-focus="initialFocus"
    :final-focus="finalFocus"
    :class="
      cn(
        'fixed inset-0 z-50 m-auto block h-fit w-[min(28rem,calc(100vw-2rem))]',
        'rounded-panel border border-line bg-raised p-6 shadow-popup outline-none',
        'motion-safe:animate-dialog-in data-ending-style:motion-safe:animate-dialog-out',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
  >
    <slot />
  </SdkAlertDialogContent>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { AlertDialogClose } from '@ui-sdk/vue/alert-dialog'
import { RenderChild } from '@/lib/render-child'
import { buttonVariants, type ButtonSize, type ButtonVariant } from '../button'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AlertDialogActionProps = {
  variant?: ButtonVariant
  size?: ButtonSize
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AlertDialogActionProps>(), {
  variant: 'primary',
  size: 'md',
  asChild: false,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialogClose
    v-bind="forwarded"
    value="confirm"
    :class="
      asChild
        ? cn(attrs.class as ClassValue)
        : cn('h-auto border-0', buttonVariants({ variant, size }), attrs.class as ClassValue)
    "
  >
    <template v-if="asChild" #render="{ props: part }">
      <RenderChild v-bind="part"><slot /></RenderChild>
    </template>
    <slot v-if="!asChild" />
  </AlertDialogClose>
</template>
